name: Constellation
summary: Files are stars. A collection is the shape you draw between them, and one star can sit in as many shapes as you like.

name: Prism
summary: Every tag is a translucent lens. Stack them and the files you want are where the colors overlap.

name: Loom
summary: Time runs left to right, projects are threads, and a file is a bead that can be strung on several threads at once.

name: Facet
summary: One set of files on a cube. Each face groups them by a different axis, and rotating the cube is how you refile.

name: Rooms and Portals
summary: An infinite canvas carved into rooms. A file placed in one room can open a portal into any other, and both ends are the same file.

name: Shelves
summary: Finish a sentence and it becomes a shelf. Files keep landing on every shelf whose sentence is true of them.

name: Transit
summary: Collections are colored lines, files are stations, and a file in several collections is where you change trains.

name: Columns of Context
summary: A board where every column is a context, and moving a card never removes it from where it already was.

name: Gravity
summary: Collections pull. Files settle where the pulls on them balance, and how far they sit from a well is how strongly they belong.

name: Orbit
summary: Center anything and everything it belongs to orbits it. Click a satellite and it becomes the center.
